reason: 14.90 for black viscose is fine, but when I buy 20 metres for a run I can't gamble on a shop I don't know, and nothing here shows me what the fabric really looks or feels like. I'll stay with the supplier whose colours and quality I already know.
objection: The colour on screen never matches the real thing, and I don't know the weight or drape either. If 20 metres turns up a different shade or thinner than I expected, my whole batch is ruined and sending it back is a pain.
would_change_my_mind: Cheap physical swatches or a sample card I can pick up from my InPost locker, plus a clear volume price for 10 m and up
